meaning.name: LatticeProb.External.SupercriticalBondUniqueness
meaning.assumption_policy: Explicit consumer binder only; no theorem, axiom, instance or paper proof credit.
meaning.command:
def SupercriticalBondUniqueness : Prop :=
  (∀ (d : ℕ) [NeZero d], 2 ≤ d →
    0 < criticalProbability d ∧ criticalProbability d < 1) ∧
  (∀ (d : ℕ) [NeZero d], 2 ≤ d → ∀ p : unitInterval,
    criticalProbability d < (p : ℝ) → (p : ℝ) < 1 →
      latticeBondLaw d p (uniqueInfiniteComponentEvent d) = 1)

conditional_consumer.name: LatticeProb.External.exists_supercritical_parameter_of_classical_input
conditional_consumer.command:
theorem exists_supercritical_parameter_of_classical_input
    (hclassical : SupercriticalBondUniqueness) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ p : unitInterval, criticalProbability d < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < 1 := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq1⟩ := exists_between (hclassical.1 d hd).2
  exact ⟨⟨q, (criticalProbability_nonneg d).trans hq0.le, hq1.le⟩, hq0, hq1⟩

(hclassical : SupercriticalBondUniqueness) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ p : unitInterval, criticalProbability d < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < 1

meaning.name: LatticeProb.External.SupercriticalBondCorrectorInput
meaning.assumption_policy: Explicit consumer binder only; qualitative cited consequence, unproved with exact meaning frozen. No theorem, axiom, instance or paper proof credit.
meaning.command:
def SupercriticalBondCorrectorInput : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ) [NeZero d], 2 ≤ d → ∀ p : unitInterval,
    criticalProbability d < (p : ℝ) → (p : ℝ) < 1 →
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂latticeBondLaw d p, ∀ h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω,
      (∀ q : Fin d → ℝ, ∀ o : uniqueInfiniteComponent h,
        ∃! u : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ,
          IsCorrectedPlane (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) q u ∧ u o = 0) ∧
      (∀ u : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ,
        u ∈ harmonicGrowthSpace (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) 1 →
        ∃! q : Fin d → ℝ, IsCorrectedPlane (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) q u)

predicate.name: LatticeProb.Percolation.IsCorrectedPlane
predicate.command:
def IsCorrectedPlane (C : OpenComponent ω) (p : Fin d → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) : Prop :=
  u ∈ harmonicGrowthSpace C 1 ∧ componentSlopeAsymptotics C p u
predicate.type: {d : ℕ} {ω : Configuration d} (C : OpenComponent ω) (p : Fin d → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) : Prop

full_characterization.name: LatticeProb.Percolation.isCorrectedPlane_iff_harmonic_and_slope_asymptotics
full_characterization.command:
theorem isCorrectedPlane_iff_harmonic_and_slope_asymptotics (C : OpenComponent ω)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) :
    IsCorrectedPlane C q u ↔
      (∀ x, componentLaplacian C u x = 0) ∧ componentSlopeAsymptotics C q u := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hh, _⟩, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hh, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hh, hs⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hh, componentL2Subpolynomial_one_of_slope_asymptotics C q u hs⟩, hs⟩
full_characterization.type:
{d : ℕ} {ω : Configuration d} (C : OpenComponent ω)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) :
    IsCorrectedPlane C q u ↔
      (∀ x, componentLaplacian C u x = 0) ∧ componentSlopeAsymptotics C q u

conditional_consumer.name: LatticeProb.Percolation.exists_two_dimensional_plane_of_cited_inputs
conditional_consumer.command:
theorem exists_two_dimensional_plane_of_cited_inputs
    (hclassical : SupercriticalBondUniqueness)
    (hcorrector : SupercriticalBondCorrectorInput) :
    ∃ p : unitInterval, criticalProbability 2 < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < 1 ∧
      ∃ (ω : Configuration 2) (h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω)
        (o : uniqueInfiniteComponent h) (u : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ),
        (∀ x, componentLaplacian (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) u x = 0) ∧
        componentSlopeAsymptotics (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) (Pi.single 0 1) u ∧
        u o = 0 ∧ ∃ x y : uniqueInfiniteComponent h, u x ≠ u y := by
  obtain ⟨p, hpc, hp1⟩ := exists_supercritical_parameter_of_classical_input hclassical 2
    (by decide)
  have hq : (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have := congrFun heq 0
    norm_num at this
  obtain ⟨ω, h, o, u, hu, hnorm, hnonconstant⟩ :=
    exists_nonconstant_normalized_plane_of_cited_inputs hclassical hcorrector 2
      (by decide) p hpc hp1 (Pi.single 0 1) hq
  have hfull := (isCorrectedPlane_iff_harmonic_and_slope_asymptotics _ _ _).mp hu
  exact ⟨p, hpc, hp1, ω, h, o, u, hfull.1, hfull.2, hnorm, hnonconstant⟩

(hclassical : SupercriticalBondUniqueness)
    (hcorrector : SupercriticalBondCorrectorInput) :

      ∃ (ω : Configuration 2) (h : HasUniqueInfiniteOpenComponent ω)
        (o : uniqueInfiniteComponent h) (u : uniqueInfiniteComponent h → ℝ),
        (∀ x, componentLaplacian (uniqueInfiniteComponent h) u x = 0) ∧
